logp.method_description: Solutions of 1, 2, 3, and 4 (25 µm) were prepared in 3 mL octanol in separate screw cap glass vials. Deionized H2O (3 mL) was added, and the vials were capped and wrapped in foil. The vials were shaken vigorously for 5 min before allowing to settle overnight (~18 h). Triplicate absorbance measurement was taken for both the octanol and water layers of each vial for each compound. LogPo/w was calculated by first solving for the quotient of the absorbance in octanol over the absorbance in water and then taking the common logarithm. Three LogPo/w values were calculated for each compound, and those values were averaged to produce the average LogPo/w values shown in Table 1, where errors are the standard deviation of the three values.
